# Wacky Lighthouse

> Free public test pages that make Lighthouse and PageSpeed Insights return a known result on purpose: a valid report, a NO_FCP runtime error or a NO_LCP error. Use them to test code that runs Lighthouse or reads its results. Free and open source (GPL-3.0), made by Taktek (https://taktek.io).

## Test pages

- [Valid Response](https://wackylighthouse.com/): a standard, valid Lighthouse report.
- [No FCP](https://wackylighthouse.com/no-fcp.html): the page never paints, so Lighthouse stops with runtimeError NO_FCP and every category score is null.
- [No LCP](https://wackylighthouse.com/no-lcp.html): the page paints only a small canvas square, so the largest-contentful-paint audit errors with NO_LCP and the performance score is null.

## Usage

- Lighthouse CLI: `npx lighthouse https://wackylighthouse.com/no-fcp.html --output=json`
- PageSpeed Insights API: `https://www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed?url=https://wackylighthouse.com/no-fcp.html`
